brief: Draws a mode as a ladder, one rung for each degree, spaced by cents, so where the notes sit is visible and not only named.
detail: A mode is shown when the question is where its notes sit and not what the melody is. Each degree is a rung whose height is its pitch and whose distance from the next is the step, so on the ladder a half-flat third sits half way between the minor and the major third, which a staff cannot show. Everything drawn is declared by the universe: a degree lowered going down is a dashed rung, a degree the sources disagree on is dotted with its source named, ajnas are brackets beside the rails. Rungs gives the numbers, ToText a text, ToSVG and SaveAs the picture. A mode name the universe does not declare falls back to its default mode without an error. No sound is played; the SVG was rendered by a headless browser and read by a model, not by a person (UNPERCEIVED).
